card.title: Move It for Me
card.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Move your haircut so we can have lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've been friends since school. Couldn't I have its place just once?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They charge twenty pounds if I change it today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll pay. Put lunch in that exact slot, in pen. You've used pencil for me since school.

mechanism: A asks B to replace a long-booked haircut with lunch as visible proof of friendship priority.
confusable: Unlike seeking any available time together, A must insist on rearranging the conflicting commitment itself.
comparison: D35-a pays the fee but wants the exact slot in ink; D35-b accepts partial attendance only with the sister openly named as the reason.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
